---
name: Enhancement request
about: Suggest an improvement to AXIOM
title: "[ENHANCEMENT] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What improvement do you want?

A clear description of the improvement.

## Why is this an improvement?

Back this up with measurements if possible. For example:
- "Current V3.1 takes 7.97s to build on 10MB. With [technique X], I measured it at 4.2s on the same corpus."
- "V3.1 uses 4.5 bits per node. [Reference] shows this can be reduced to 2.5 bits per node with [technique Y]."

## How would you implement it?

A brief technical sketch. You don't need full code, just the approach.

## Are you willing to implement this yourself?

- [ ] Yes, I'll submit a PR
- [ ] No, just suggesting

## Does this affect the paper's claims?

- [ ] Yes — it would change a number in the paper
- [ ] No — it's an implementation detail

## References

Links to papers, blog posts, or other implementations that support the improvement.
